name: Dual Marching Cubes Table Generation
definition: An algorithm to generate the lookup table for the Dual Marching Cubes (DualMC) surface extraction method. It maps each of the 256 possible cube corner configurations (inside/outside) to a set of dual point edge masks that define the extracted surface geometry.
summary: Dual Marching Cubes Table Generation is an offline algorithm that constructs a lookup table mapping cube configurations to dual point edge masks for efficient GPU mesh construction.
